description: Land Title Settlement Department - Kanewala, Horana D/S Division, Kalutara District - Cad. Map No. 530179
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains detailed declarations of land parcel determinations, specific plot numbers, cadastral map references, and individual land ownership details for multiple properties in Kanewala village. The content focuses entirely on land registration and property rights without any government personnel changes, structural reorganizations, or other non-land related administrative matters.
